title: A Cover for the Cipher
author: C. M. Vane
blurb: Noor Winterbourne, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
